entities.name: René Petit
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Renato Petit de Ory, better known by his French name, René Petit, was a Franco-Spanish engineer, known for being a footballer in his youth. He was one of the most popular players in Spanish football in the 1910s, 1920s, and 1930s, playing for Real Madrid and Real Unión, and becoming a member of the France national team. He represented France at the 1920 Summer Olympics in Belgium.
